ability.name: Step 3 - Install Nmap
ability.description: Installs Nmap silently via winget or choco if missing.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $nmapAvailable = $false; try { if (nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String "Nmap") { $nmapAvailable = $true } } catch {}; if (-not $nmapAvailable) { Write-Output "Installing Nmap via winget..."; winget install -e --id Insecure.Nmap --silent --accept-package-agreements 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Get-Command nmap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output "Winget failed. Trying choco..."; choco install nmap -y 2>&1 } }; if (nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String "Nmap") { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step3 failed - $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step3.txt

rationale: Ensures nmap is available for subsequent scanning operations.
